articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Deutsche Bank Raid Revives Compliance Questions Despite Profits And Valuation Upside. German authorities have raided Deutsche Bank's Frankfurt offices as part of a money laundering probe into historical transactions involving entities linked to Roman Abramovich. The investigation focuses on transactions between 2013 and 2018 and adds fresh scrutiny to the bank's compliance controls.
